topic: What Elon Musk Really Thinks About Sam Altman

youtube.title: What Elon Musk Really Thinks About Sam Altman
youtube.description:
What Elon Musk really thinks about Sam Altman: He wanted the chair. Sam kept it.

Two friends put a long table in a lab. In 2017 Musk asked for the boss chair. The Honest Thoughts mail said no. He called it the final straw and left. ChatGPT got famous without him. He built a table next door, sued, and in May 2026 a jury said he waited too late.

This illustrated documentary from What They Really Think tells that story from mail, posts, filings, and OpenAI's blog. We cannot see inside their heads.

Sources / further reading:
- OpenAI, Elon Musk wanted an OpenAI for-profit (2024)
- Honest Thoughts email exhibit, Musk v. Altman (2017)
- OpenAI, OpenAI Supporters (2018)
- Musk v. Altman, N.D. Cal. advisory jury (May 18, 2026)
